anchor: stored observed Day-60 target date; retrospective score estimation, not publication-time prediction
cut_rule: sort training anchor dates, use zero-based floor(N*fraction); all equal dates stay together; no outcome-based adjustment
intervals: fit anchor < assessment start; assessment start <= anchor < end; all fitting targets strictly predate assessment
group_rule: connected components of exact accepted document text after NFC and whitespace normalization; case and punctuation preserved; no URL or CVE-mention links
group_purge: exclude fitting members of components touching assessment; retain every assessment CVE; never reassign official roles
support_interpretation: operational review thresholds, not a power calculation or assurance of significance; no fold is redrawn after counts
future_comparison: standalone-context D versus DM pooled MSE; same assessment CVEs; no fit implemented by this audit
future_preprocessing: refit scaling, categorical vocabulary and any ridge penalty selection inside each fitting fold; do not reuse outer-training-fitted structured vectors
future_selection: no selection on the inner assessment labels; use a further chronological fitting-only selection split or a separately frozen epoch budget
oof_policy: one assessment prediction per covered CVE and seed, report pooled and per-fold metrics; initial warmup and omitted records remain explicit; no promise of covering every high-score training CVE
